title: swcat catalog entity
description: A single swcat catalog entity (one YAML document). Catalog files may contain several documents separated by '---'.

apiVersion.description: The schema version of this entity descriptor.

kind.description: The entity kind. Determines the shape of 'spec'.

name.description: Letters, digits and '-'; must start with a letter and end with a letter or digit. At most 63 characters.

anyRef.description: An entity reference: `[<kind>:][<namespace>/]<name>`, e.g. `component:payments/checkout`. The kind is lowercase; the namespace defaults to `default`.

apiLabelRef.description: A reference to an API, either as a string ('api:ns/name @v2 "label"', version and label optional) or as a record.

dependsOnRef.description: A dependency on a Component or Resource. The kind is mandatory here, e.g. 'component:foo' or 'resource:bar "reads"'.

label.description: A label shown on the edge in relationship diagrams.

attrs.description: Additional attributes. 'version' selects a declared API version.

name.description: The name of the entity. Unique per namespace and kind.

namespace.description: The namespace the entity belongs to. Defaults to 'default'.

title.description: A display name shown in the UI instead of 'name'.

description.description: A short, one-line description of the entity.

labels.description: Key/value pairs of identifying information (Kubernetes label rules).

annotations.description: Key/value pairs of non-identifying auxiliary information, mostly used by plugins and custom content. Values must be strings; use a block scalar (|) for embedded JSON.

tags.description: Single-valued strings used to classify entities.

links.description: External hyperlinks related to the entity.

url.description: The link target, in standard URI format.

title.description: A user friendly display name for the link.

icon.description: A key representing a visual icon to display in the UI.

type.description: An optional value to categorize links into groups.

owner.description: The Group that owns this domain. Must exist in the catalog.

subdomainOf.description: A Domain of which this domain is a part.

type.description: The type of domain. Free-form unless restricted by catalog.validation in the swcat config.

owner.description: The Group that owns this system. Must exist in the catalog.

domain.description: The Domain this system belongs to. Required by swcat, and must exist in the catalog.

type.description: The type of system. Free-form unless restricted by catalog.validation in the swcat config.
The type of component, e.g. 'service' or 'job'. Free-form unless restricted by catalog.validation in the swcat config.

lifecycle.description: The lifecycle state, e.g. 'production' or 'experimental'. Free-form unless restricted by catalog.validation in the swcat config.

owner.description: The Group that owns this component. Must exist in the catalog.

system.description: The System this component belongs to. Must exist in the catalog.

subcomponentOf.description: A Component of which this component is a part.

providesApis.description: The APIs provided by this component.

consumesApis.description: The APIs consumed by this component.

dependsOn.description: Components and Resources this component depends on to function.

type.description: The type of resource, e.g. 'database' or 'cache'. Free-form unless restricted by catalog.validation in the swcat config.

owner.description: The Group that owns this resource. Must exist in the catalog.

system.description: The System this resource belongs to. Must exist in the catalog.

dependsOn.description: Components and Resources this resource depends on to function.

type.description: The type of API definition, e.g. 'grpc/protobuf' or 'openapi'. Free-form unless restricted by catalog.validation in the swcat config.

lifecycle.description: The lifecycle state of the API. If 'versions' is given, at least one version must have this lifecycle.

owner.description: The Group that owns this API. Must exist in the catalog.

system.description: The System this API belongs to. Must exist in the catalog.

definition.description: The API definition, in the format implied by 'type'. Optional in swcat.

versions.description: The versions in which this API currently exists. Consumers and providers can select one with `@<version>`.

lifecycle.description: The lifecycle state of this particular version.

type.description: The type of group, e.g. 'team'. Free-form unless restricted by catalog.validation in the swcat config.

profile.description: Profile information about the group, for display purposes.

displayName.description: A display name to present to users.

email.description: An email address where the group can be reached.

picture.description: URL of an image representing this group.

parent.description: The immediate parent group in the hierarchy.

children.description: The immediate child groups (whose 'parent' points to this group).

members.description: The users that are members of this group. Uninterpreted strings.
